nom: Live Tinted Hueguard 3-in-1 Mineral Sunscreen, Moisturizer, Primer SPF 30

avis.texte: This product does not have a white cast but it does have a yellow tint that does not blend out or fade after application. I am fair skin with freckles so this is not a good look for me. It also doesn't absorb well. I went to blow my nose a good 30 minutes after application and the tissue was yellow. The only positive about it is that I also have textured skin and it didn't cling to my dry patches.

avis.titre: A perfect mineral sunscreen - after some finishing touches
avis.texte: I agree with other reviews that say that this mineral-based sunscreen is almost perfect. My one gripe about this is how greasy and tacky it initially feels on my skin. I don't wear foundation, so I thought that maybe it doesn't do great as a standalone product despite it saying it can be worn by itself. I put it on, put on my blush, and finished off with the Fenty setting powder. Bam! Perfect. It doesn't pill, stays on all day for 12+ hours, and doesn't transfer to my phone. I can touch my face and it doesn't feel greasy at all. If you want something that's great for perioral dermatitis and doesn't break you out, and you don't mind using another product with it, it's a 10/10.
This is the only sunscreen I use! It rubs in clear with absolutely no white cast on my skin tone. Love it!
Last step in my morning routine for face and back of hands. Goes on clear, I believe it's reef-friendly also? Only drawback is that it starts to crumble toward the end of the stick

The application is great. It applies well. Love that it was a three and one, but it did not absorb into my skin and left me greasy. It would transfer onto my phone. It also made me break out with cystic acne after starting this product. I don't have super sensitive skin. I wanted to love this, but I will not be buying it again.

avis.titre: Best sunscreen ever for type 2 Rosacea
avis.texte: I've been struggling to find a sunscreen that doesn't trigger my flare ups and this one really out did itself
I bought this online and received a product that was about two months past its expiration date. Please check the expiration date on the bottom of the product before applying!

avis.titre: Finally found a sunscreen that I like
avis.texte: My philosophy when it comes to sunscreen is that it has to be something that feels good when I apply it to the skin. I wear sunscreen everyday, so it's incredibly important that the sunscreen is easy to apply and doesn't leave white cast for me. This sunscreen checks all my boxes AND serves as a primer. Love it!

The cosmetic elegance of Live Tinted's Hueguard 3-in-1 sunscreen is unmatched. This wears like a dream under makeup and provides a blurring effect when worn alone. It's moisturizing, works under literally every foundation I've tried it with, and it just continually impresses me. . . especially for having to follow US UV filter restrictions. AND it's 100% mineral sunscreen. . . hello?!?! I've tried it under probably a dozen different foundation/concealer products and it just WORKS. I tried to find alternatives, dupes, anything that would give me the same experience as this formula. Truly there is no comparison, it is just so good. Live Tinted knows their stuff, and I have already been through several bottles of this and I will continue to repurchase for as long as they make it. While I would not alter the consistency/finish of this formula a single bit - I am excited to see what they come up with next now that some of the restrictions in the US have changed. If I had to make any tweak, I would love a higher SPF like 50-70.

I cannot praise this product enough. It's really helped to improve my skin, and I'm obsessed with the weightless feel. I've always struggled with wearing sunscreen on my face because it either makes me break out or makes my rosacea flare up. I looove how smoothly it goes on; it feels like I have nothing on my face. I'm literally squeezing out what's left in my current bottle! More than anything, I've received so many comments on how healthy and young my skin looks.

I've been really enjoying the HUEGUARD® 3-in-1 Mineral Sunscreen, Moisturizer, Primer SPF 30. It feels lightweight on the skin, blends in easily, and doesn't leave a heavy or greasy finish. I love that it combines sun protection, hydration, and a smooth makeup-ready base in one step. It wears well throughout the day and layers nicely under makeup, making my morning routine much simpler. A great everyday SPF option! ☀️✨

I have acne, prone skin, so it's hard for me to find a good sunscreen that sits nicely underneath my makeup and also looks good on its own without clogging my pores, or causing me to break out, but this one is perfect! Not only doesn't leave any type of weird cast. It melts into the skin so effortlessly, and looks great on its own and performs really well under makeup as well!

I love almost everything about this sunscreen. My negatives are the orange color, which can take a long time to rub in completely (sometimes I will find an orange patch on my face) and the pump is awful. The product gives you a nice glow and feels great on skin

avis.titre: The product that does it all!
avis.texte: I absolutely love how the HUEGUARD® 3-in-1 Mineral Sunscreen, Moisturizer, Primer SPF 30 moisturizes and prepped my skin for a full day of makeup in the summer heat! As a busy mom of 3, it's a must that I have a simple, effective skincare and makeup routine. This 3-1 allows me to lessen the products on my counter, as well as look my best with a simplified routine.

As someone with oily skin, I'm picky about SPF, but this one has been such a good find. It feels lightweight, blends easily, perfect under makeup. Plus, no white cast — just comfortable daily sun protection.

This sunscreen really surprised me in the best way! It doesn't leave a white cast or feels sticky and heavy on the skin. It is really moisturizing and lightweight and even blurs the skin so even without any makeup the skin looks more glowy and even. After applying the rest of my makeup it didn't pill or separate so it really worked amazing as a makeup prep base!

This stuff is gorgeous! I was initially a little intimidated by its orange color, but rest assured it sheers out completely and leaves no color on my super fair skin. The formula is so silky and hydrating. . it feels like a nice, lightweight moisturizer. Since I am on the drier side I apply this over my moisturizer and under my makeup as a primer and it wears beautifully! I also wear this on no makeup days and it works great that way too. I am very acne prone and this formula has caused no irritation and no new breakouts for me. This is a great choice for a daily spf and I could see this working for just about anyone!

This primer sunscreen has been a lifesaver for my daily makeup routine. It perfectly moisturizes my skin, protects and keeps it fresh throughout the day without leaving any residue. The packaging is beautiful and unique.

Wow! This was such a great product. The consistency was so light on the skin. It was so hydrating and provided such a great base for my makeup keeping it in place all day while also providing SPF 30! It gave my skin such a beautiful glow! Love that there is no scent and had absolutely no white cast. Just a great product that I will definitely be purchasing again and again.

It looks very interesting product at the first impression. Very orange color and when it blends it becomes transparent not tinted at all it did give me the glow as soon as applied it and very hydrating but after one hour it just dried out and did seem to be anymore tinted spf. But the first look it does make the difference

I just started using the Live Tinted HUEGUARD 3-in-1 Mineral Sunscreen Moisturizer & Primer and absolutely love it! I wear SPF daily and having one that serves as a primer as well as offering SPF 30 is a bonus! I love that it isn't at all sticky and does not leave a white cast or interfere with my other products. It glides on easily, absorbs very quickly and leaves a beautiful subtle glow. It's perfect for daily use, and under make-up and the slim tube packaging makes it very convenient to throw into a small bag for reapplication, on the go. The orange color threw me off at first but it left no discoloration whatsoever. Now a staple product in my daily routine!

avis.titre: The texture is so unique and have a hint of glowy
avis.texte: I'm surprised by this Hueguard , as a sunscreen lover , and a busy mom, have 3 in one, to moisture, prep and protect from the sun in less time that applying 3 different products, I found this one a holy grail. First of all, it's fragrance free, second, goes pretty well with my sensitive skin and third but not least, it's just one application and you are done! It's SPF 30, yes, and you can keep re-applying as necessary. Definitely one of my favorite discoveries nowadays.

This 3-in-1 mineral sunscreen moisturizer does have a white cast. I was excited to receive this because I firmly believe you should have multiple sunscreens for different reasons; however, this does leave a white cast, no matter how much you rub it in. I did my whole morning skincare routine only to have to wash it off because of the cast. If you are on the more fair side, it is a lightweight formula and there is a lightweight feel

I've been using this tinted moisturizer and its 3-in-1 solution for a few days now, and I'm thoroughly impressed with the results. I used to spend a lot of time applying each of the three products separately, but with this solution, I save so much time without compromising on coverage. The consistency is great, providing a flawless finish. Overall, I'm very satisfied with it and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient and effective skincare product.

With HUEGUARD® 3-in-1 Mineral Sunscreen, Moisturizer & Primer SPF 30, I feel so much more comfortable going out in the sun. It's lightweight, not greasy, and keeps my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I also love that it works as sunscreen, moisturizer, and primer all in one, it makes my routine so simple. My skin just feels good all day, and I don't worry as much when I'm outside.

avis.titre: Lightweight SPF That Simplifies My Routine
avis.texte: I've been loving the Live Tinted HUEGUARD® 3-in-1 Mineral Sunscreen, Moisturizer, Primer SPF 30. It feels lightweight, creamy, and blends easily into my skin. I apply it every morning, and it leaves my skin looking smooth, hydrated, and more even.I love that it combines moisturizer, SPF, and primer in one step, which has made my morning routine faster and easier. It creates a great base under makeup, feels comfortable all day, and never pills. Compared to other mineral sunscreens I've tried, this one feels much lighter and gives my skin a natural, healthy-looking finish. I'd definitely recommend it.

I like how easy this Hueguard sunscreen is to use. It works as sunscreen, moisturizer, and primer, so it saves me time in the morning. The texture feels lightweight and hydrating, and it sits well under makeup without pilling.It gives a slight blur to the skin and doesn't feel greasy. I also like that it's mineral-based and fragrance-free, so it feels gentle on my skin. It's a solid everyday sunscreen, especially if you want something simple and multitasking.

avis.titre: Gives a nice glow and protection
avis.texte: Live Tinted Hueguard Mineral Sunscreen is a lightweight mineral SPF that blends in easily and feels comfortable on the skin. It gives a natural, skin-like finish and sits well under makeup, making it a solid everyday sunscreen. ✨

I love how it's a one step product especially with no white cast. I'm able to use it with and without makeup and obtain amazing results. Under my make up it works amazing as a primer, doesn't make my product layering patchy at all. So far no breakouts and does leave a beautiful dewy finish. Love it!

When I use the same amount of sunscreen that I would use when applying a chemical sunscreen with Hueguard, a minimal white cast shows up on my skin. However, if I only use four pumps on my face then it is undetectable. For people who use makeup, I think you could use the dermatologist recommended amount and be able to cover it easily.

I tried the Live Tinted Hueguard 3-in-1 Mineral SPF 30 and I really like how easy it is to use. It blended in no time with no white cast, which makes it so easy to incorporate into my daily routine.It feels lightweight and hydrating on my skin, softly blurs, and leaves a healthy glow without looking greasy. I also love that it works as sunscreen, moisturizer, and primer in one, so it feels practical for everyday wear and sits nicely under makeup too.

I've been testing the Tinted Live Hueguard sunscreen and I actually like it. The texture feels lightweight and it blends nicely into the skin without feeling too heavy. I wouldn't say I'm completely obsessed with it, but it gives a smooth natural finish and works well under makeup. Definitely a good everyday SPF option if you like simple glowy skin

avis.titre: I've only used it a couple of times.  So far so good.
avis.texte: I just got this and have only used it a few times. So far so good.

I was looking for a physical sunscreen that did not have that white cast. This is great because it's tinted just enough and serves as a light moisturizer and primer for me. I do apply it generously in layers because it's only spf 30.

It's my first trying Tinted and I'm already loving this brand. I have combo skin and finding right mineral spf has been difficult as they are either making me more oily or have white cast with ashy finish. This multitasker has non of the above mentioned issues. My skin feels hydrated, makeup looks great and doesn't pill, formula absorbs fast without making me oily. Definitely recommend it, this 3 in 1 product is amazing!
My husband and I like it. Been using it for a few years. We like that it's clean, light and not greasy.
I love the HUEGUARD® Skin Tint SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum. It be be worn on its own or for extra coverage under the HUEGUARD® Skin Tint SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen Broad Spectrum.

avis.titre: Great sun protection stick until it broke
avis.texte: I fully finished my first one, my 2nd purchase however was disappointing since the stick broke on its own and now the whole stick is wasted. I contemplated buying it again but not sure if this will have the same fate so didn't purchase it in my latest order. I do love sun protection on the go, disappointed with the new quality
I love this sunscreen! It blends incredibly well and is very clean! I love that it has no chemical sunscreen boosters.
I love this tinted sunscreen! Keeps my skin moisturized all day and protects from sun.

My sister introduced me to this brand and it is fabulous:) doesn't make me break out! and the jumbo bottle lasted me the whole summer(varies for all as it depends how much you use daily. ) I recommend!

I have been on a hunt for a sunscreen with clean ingredients and no case for my skin tone. Unfortunately I haven't had much luck with mineral sunscreens. So I gave this product a shot and it definitely has no cast and leaves your skin with a natural dewy hydrated look a perfect base for makeup or a no makeup kinda day

I bought 2 since I really wanted to support a small business and south east Asian owned brand. I wanted to love the product but within a month both of the broke. I wrote the team and they were kind enough to send me 2 more . And those two broke as easily too. Whereas I had Sheseido do months and our entire family used them and no issues what so ever.
Literally the perfect sunscreen, feels amazing on the skin, blends in so well with no white cast. If you have medium skin don't think just buy.
This product is a convenient, all-in-one solution designed to make quick errands simple and hassle-free.
I do like the consistency of this product but elf whoa glow is a better price and has a better natural tint than this. That will be my go to
If this is tinted, I can't tell so it's going back to the store.

I bought this during the sale because I was not happy with my old sunscreen. I've tried multiple mineral sunscreens and so far this is the best. It does not flare my rocesea and looks beautiful on its own. It does have a chemical smell in the begining but it goes away after it settles. It dries down beautifully and doesn't feel like it's shifting thru the day. This is my new holy grail! I do not recommend it for tones darker than mine tho as it does have a slight white cast on my medium skin tone.
Easy to apply. Does not smell like you're wearing sunscreen, which is an absolute plus for me! And it feels good on my face!
Love the ease of use, flawless non-shiny look after application.

The sunscreen itself is just okay. The thing that made me return it was the awful smell. It's so off-putting, almost resembling spoiled milk. The expiration date isn't until 8/2028, so I think that's how it's supposed to smell. I decided to return it because I'd rather use the other tinted mineral sunscreens out there that don't smell this gross.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: Unfortunately, there was a pretty noticeable white cast on this tinted sunscreen. I was trying to see if it would be a good alternative to Bubble's tinted spf…it was not. I returned it and bought two of the bubble ones lol
this product pilled on my skin. I applied after my skincare dried down, did not put makeup over it, and just flaked off like dry skin. also tinted my eyebrows an orange hue.
Pleasantly surprised with this product. I love how it feels on my skin and my make up sits much better then with any other primer I use.
So far I'm really enjoying this product. It applies really nicely and blends in well. I wouldn't say it has a lot of coverage but it did give me a nice dewy glow which I really liked!

Applied this over my skincare. hoping it wouldn't pill. Boy am I just so happy!! I appreciate that it blended so nicely added concealer for under eyes, then balm blush, bronzer and set with powder. This lasted all day and my face was protected while I was outdoors.

I got a deluxe sample of this and it is the first western sunscreen that hasnt made my eyes sting. I am about a NC45 and there is no white cast for me - I recommend making sure any skincare underneath has dried/settled or it takes longer to rub in and "set". I have combination skin and for the most part it hasnt been greasy. It blurs my skin and makes it look nicer. I will definitely be full sizing, I am hyperpigmentation-prone so tinted sunscreen helps cover it better while it fades. It is a little runny in the 0.5 oz so the size between that and the 5.0 oz might be easier to manage the amount dispensed.

avis.titre: Beautiful SPF That Leaves My Skin So Moisturized
avis.texte: This is a beautiful SPF + primer that leaves my skin feeling moisturized and gives a glow before I apply the Skin Tint. Highly recommend.
I didnt buy this myself ( I took it from my mom) lol but it is sooooo good i wear it every day layered with my skincare and makeup it has the perfect sheer tint

avis.titre: Only SPF for my face that doesn't burn my eyes
avis.texte: I love this stuff! Ive tried many face sunscreens including mineral and chemical and they all cause my eyes to burn throughout the day, even if I'm not sweating. This is the only one that doesn't. Also layers great with makeup. I do moizturizer first, then this sunscreen, then primer, then my skin tint or foundation. I give about 5 minutes between each step to let the products sink in and my skin looks flawless. Doesnt cake up or cause my makeup to pill!
such a great spf doesnt feel greasy or heavy on skin. gives skin a nice glow I love this spf!💕
LOVE this product. It has been a staple in my daily routine for the last two years!

been using this spf for years now & i always come back to it as a brown girl with hyperpigmented prone skin. it has iron oxides, leaves no white cast despite being a mineral spf, & wears great under makeup! doesn't make my eyes burn either

avis.titre: One Size All Tinted Sunscreen Works
avis.texte: I was apprehensive about this product,but curious because it blocked the sun and blue light. The product is a tan color, which I thought would make my skin yellow. It did not. The color blended with my own skin tone (fair) and smoothed the texture. I applied Ilia stick foundation after. Perfection. Was looking for a less greasy sunscreen option that was make up friendly. I think I found it.

This sunscreen sits on top of my skin and looks terrible. It also irritates my sensitive skin and rosacea. I'm glad I ordered the smallest sample size. I will be tossing this product and continuing my search for new sunscreen.

Love this as an everyday sunscreen. No white cast after it dries. It also applies nicely when I do full face makeup. It's nice and light like a lotion. The only con is the price for the amount you get.
Love the sunscreen. Primer. Use it under the skin tint and by itself. It's my HG. NO piling. Works perfect.
With or aithout makeup this givea glowing!! But fresh and natural!

avis.titre: Almost Perfect! Not for Dry Skin
avis.texte: This sunscreen is super lightweight, non-greasy, plays well under makeup, and has solid full spectrum protection….however it is not moisturizing for my dry/combo skin. In fact it drys me out even after applying it over a moisturizing serum and cream - it's like it sucks through the barrier and my skin is left feeling
Bought this the first time. Used one time. Loved it. Bought 3 more instantly. Big mistake. Started noticing it just chips/breaks off every time I apply. So frustrating and a big waste of money.

I hated the stuff the first time I put it on. hours later and my skin still feels sticky. It's horrible under my makeup and make it look so bad after only an hour that I had to remove everything. It also made me get acne. I should have known since I don't believe in products that say they have SPF moisturizer and primer all in one. There's no way and this one doesn't work.

No breakouts. No stinging or rashes. No greasy feel. No Niacinamide!!! After a long search im stopping at this sunscreen for my everyday. If im going to be outside in the sun all day i opt for my ISDIN but this one is perfect for work and days im in/out.

I often buy one œbeauty product  that I think will work, if only I'd use it! This is one of those things I bought. Well, turns out this one is actually one I do use! The tint helps even out my skin tone and I appreciate that I get a moisturizer and sunscreen in it to boot. It completely simplifies my morning routine. Also, the application is maybe my favorite part a pump that is smooth to operate and pumps out an amount perfect for fingertip application.
I took this stick on a beach vacation and it made reapplication so easy! It was super dewey on application so just something to be aware of. Did not get burned the whole trip!

avis.titre: Loved my first tube not the second quality control issue
avis.texte: I first got this as a sample and one of the gifts and I fell in love with it and bought the regular size one. My sample bottle was wonderful, but my purchased bottle was an odd runny texture, even though it wasn't expired and just didn't go on the same Definitely seem to have some quality control issues.
This is the only SPF I use now! Love how it doesn't leave a white cast on my skin and it also serves as a primer for under makeup!
This Moisturizer is light but perfect as a primer, and the best part is that is has spf. And unlike others, I got NO WHITECAST. Awesome alone, or under foundation or a skin tint.

I'll start off by saying that I do love this product and would recommend it for someone who's got normal to slightly dryer skin. I'm just frustrated that my online order I've recieved (12/5/25 delivery) has a product with an expiration date for 12/2025 and I placed my order 11/30/25... some quality control, whether store level or distributing center, would be greatly appreciated because I now have to go out of my way to return this item to hopefully get one that isn't expired.
Like that it's a mineral since and that it doesn't leave a white cast. Goes well with the skin tint.
My favorite SPF! It blends in so easily and doesn't feel heavy on my skin

This is, no contest, the best sunscreen on the market, and I've tried tons. Genuinely so lightweight. A natural satin finish. No white cast yet the tint sheers out completely on my fair skin, whereas most "universal" tints leave me somewhat orange or simply don't remove the white cast. It feels so silky without being greasy whatsoever. Zero pilling. Great under makeup. Less drying than most mineral sunscreens even at 18% zinc oxide. Honestly magical.

This is, without contest, the best sunscreen on the market - and I've tried a ton. Genuinely so lightweight with a satin finish. No white cast yet the tint sheers out completely on my fair skin. It feels super silky while not being greasy whatsoever. No pilling. Great under makeup. It provides noticeable blur and is very calming to my rosacea-prone skin. Less drying than most mineral sunscreens too. Honestly magic.

I have been using this since it came out a few years ago. It's the best thing I can put under make up. My skin is naturally a little oily but I like dewy make up looks at the same time, and I think this product matte-fies my face a little bit, helps my make up look more blended and stay on longer, while not being so matte that I don't look nicely moisturized. I LOVE it!

I bought this product because an altar. Sales woman said that this would be good for under my makeup to give me a Dewey look it did not do that at all. It did just the opposite. It made me so white and pasting so I am returning it.
I got my sample pack from safora for my birthday and i love the product. Personally being someone who doesn't like foundation the sightly tinted moisturizer is a hit. Thank u

avis.titre: My fav primer AND my fav sunscreen
avis.texte: I love this stuff, I have sensitive skin that's prone to rosacea flares and this is such a great daily step in my skincare whether I want to put makeup on or not. It never pills under my foundation or nars tinted moisturizer and it also never makes me look like a ghost. The best!

Holy grail status. Repurchased this a dozen times over the years and have converted family and friends to it. Truly lightweight and no white cast. Feels a little tacky/sticky for a few minutes but dries down!
I have been repurchasing this product since it was released. Perfect for brown skin

I'm not sure it's a true moisture it dry my face out pretty bad, although you definitely don't have to worry about afternoon shine. I wish the sunscreen ingredients were a higher quality and health conscious like La Roche posay sunscreen.

No white cast, blends into my lighter skintone, leaves a natural finish (not super dewy, not chalky matte) and smells faintly of carrots at first? Sometimes I skip foundation or base makeup when I wear this. I've lost count how many times I've repurchased.

I love this sunscreen. There are no pore clogging ingredients. It leaves my oily skin refreshed and balanced and I love the higher sun protection. I use this on the weekend and the tinted one for work days when I want more coverage.
Love this product. It goes on smooth and leaves no white caste. Hard to find a sunscreen with this amount of zinc oxide so this is a great find.

avis.titre: Love!! Easy way to look my best!
avis.texte: Beautiful coverage, feels like a better more rested version of my skin! Love the wearability and color range!! I've been so exited about this product and love it!!

So I got this as a free sample and I had to buy the full size. I was looking for a sunscreen that protected and left no white cast and this does that and more. There is no white cast and it's a moisturizer and a primer, plus it feels light on skin
I love the primer base for makeup too. I have very sensitive screen and have had no reaction. It goes on smoothly and blends evenly.

I really wanted to love it because the founder is South Asian and it is meant to be for our skin. Unfortunately it left a white cast, peeled on my skin, and really made me eyes burn. I dont normally have sensitive skin so this was uncommon for me. Really disappointed, especially aboit the whote cast

avis.titre: Not a Daily Sunscreen for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I like this sunscreen but only if I plan to wear makeup during the day. I dont usually wear makeup daily, but when I'm on trips or going out during the day and want to look nice Ill wear a little bit of makeup (concealer, powder, bronzer, blush). This stuff works GREAT as a sunscreen + primer as my makeup sticks to it so well. It also does not leave any white cast, but make sure to rub in well as it dries fast on the skin and can sometimes leave streaks. I dont like to use it daily as it does not combine well with my topical acne medications (makes my face feel VERY sticky - which is nice when using makeup, but not nice without makeup). Also, I feel as thought it is pretty drying on my skin due to the mattifying effect and I'm a very oily gal. Using daily tends to slighty irritate my skin and cause dry patches. That being said, if youre a sweaty and oily faced person like me, this stuff is a holy grail to use under makeup - but if you also have sensitive skin, I dont recommend using daily.

This sunscreen/moisturizer/primer is fantastic in my opinion. My skin is very sensitive and responds best to mineral sunscreens. I also have a light skin tone but I am of eastern european and arab descent and my skin does have an olive undertoneand. A lot of mineral sunscreens will leave a slight white cast on me. This does not! I like that it feels very light and is not shiny or ultra matte after it dries down. I see that some people complain about an odd "smell" with this product and I do notice a slight smell BUT I don't notice it being overpowering and it seems to disappear after several seconds. I absolutely adore this stuff and it works perfectly for me. I will definitely buy this sunscreen again.
I received this as a sample, an loved it. I ususlly mix it with my bb cream and it adds nice moisture to my dry skin.
Good product, the only thing I don't like about it is the smell. It's not due to fragrance. I first thought it was spoilt and got a replacement but the smell was still there. I won't repurchase this
ok this is my favourite product in the whole world! I buy the jumbo one twice a year. Really good sun protection, really lovely tint. Amazing base for makeup. I always recommend this to people!

avis.titre: Don't recommend to anyone w/ deeper than light-medium skin
avis.texte: This sunscreen left a pretty significant white cast. I have around medium-tan olive skin (Armani Luminous Silk foundation shade 7.8), so there are many deeper skin tones than what I have. I wasn't even applying the recommended amount and still got a white cast. This was particularly disappointing from a brand and product that claims to be inclusive.
This goes on so smooth and works great under my tinted moisturizer. No white cast. No eraser-like shavings when applying another product over it. Mineral sunscreen is better for you.

I received a mini formulation of this for free in one of the gift bags and I could not wait to get back into town to buy the full size to wear for the rest of summer! I am a pro make up artist and this lays under every foundation I have beautifully!
This sunscreen leaves no white cast on my pale skin. Its my holy grail, it doesnt flare up my rosacea (which most sunscreens do) and doesnt make me break out. I love ittt

This sunscreen is AMAZING. Its the only sunscreen that doesnt flare up my rosacea nor make me breakout. As a pale girlie i thought the orange color would not suit me but omg it blends right into the skin and looks like im wearing nothing.
I love the products they are great but the bottles I have are faulty and always get everything dirty.
